title: Development and validation of a cumulative risk model and assessment tool for radiation-induced hypothyroidism in head and neck cancer: a multicentre study.
snippet: Radiation-induced hypothyroidism (RIHT) is a common late toxicity after head and neck radiotherapy. We aimed to develop and externally validate a multimodal Cox model for patient-specific cumulative RIHT risk assessment.
